name: Vinati Organics Limited
summary: Vinati Organics Limited manufactures and sells specialty organic intermediaries and monomers in India and internationally. The company offers specialty monomers comprising 2-acrylamido 2-methylpropane sulphonic acid, sodium salt of 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulphonic acid, N-tertiary butyl acrylamide, and N-tertiary octyl acrylamide. It also provides specialty aromatics, including iso butyl benzene used as a basic raw material in the pharmaceutical and perfume industries; normal butyl benzene that is used in the production of N-aryl azoles; secondary butyl benzene and 3-phenylpentane that are used in perfumery and flavor industries; tertiary amyl benzene, which is used as an ingredient of…
